name: Charm Person, Greater
body:
Level bard 3, mesmerist 3, occultist 3, psychic 3, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3; Focus supremacy 2

DESCRIPTION

As charm person, but the target’s friendly and helpful attitudes towards other creatures is set to indifferent, and other creatures are prevented from raising its attitude towards them. It remembers its other relationships, good or bad, but feels no particular attachment towards them for the duration. It will favor assisting you within the limits of its Friendly attitude over other tasks, as long as forgoing those tasks doesn’t harm it or violate its alignment.
